family: All simple labeled 18-regular graphs on 43 vertices with neither K5 nor independent5, and their 24-regular complements; no automorphism, packing, saved parent or fixed neighborhood is imposed.
mechanism: Exact realization constraints on the actual 24-vertex neighborhoods of the 24-regular color. Every such neighborhood must belong to the complete R(4,5;24) catalog and have at least 128 edges. Use concrete overlap graphs, not aggregate induced-subgraph densities.
first_output_gate: A complete exclusion certificate for the whole regular18/24 target branch, or a physical good43. Mere catalog counts, nonempty compatibility tables, reduced denominators and solver UNKNOWN do not meet the gate.
failure_boundary: If the first concrete overlap mechanism retains a checkable unresolved support, preserve that failed gate without another overlap-depth, catalog threshold, degree, backend or carrier refinement.
separation: No target SAT solve, q10 formula, prior aggregate density witness refinement, H92/H93 subsystem, product-core or saved-parent repair.
density_bridge: For the 18-regular color, A=N(v) has size18, B=nonneighbors(v) has size24. Set a=e(G[A]), b=e(complement(G)[B]). Regularity gives a+b=213; a<=U18=85, hence b>=128. Complementing gives a 24-regular color whose every neighborhood is an R(4,5;24) graph with >=128 edges.

inputs.U18_source: accepted local-extremal deficiency extrema.json; upstream catalog completeness imported

result: All cross-template pairings excluded by two exact overlap inequalities; no self-overlap restriction is part of the theorem.
